questions.question: "Heritage Brew" is a traditional tea company with a rich 50-year history. While their product is premium and ethically sourced, their digital presence is outdated. They currently post static photos once a month on Facebook, a platform where their current audience is primarily aged 45+. To survive, they must modernize and attract a younger audience (Ages 18–34) who value sustainability and brand stories. A) Identify the primary platform that appeals to the 18–34 age group and specialises in "Visual + trends" and explain why your choice of social media platform is a better fit for this brand’s new focus on "Visual Storytelling" compared to their current Facebook strategy. B) Suggest a few SMM strategies suitable for the company. And validate your choice of strategies. C) Suggest two specific Brand Mnemonics that Heritage Brew can use to ensure their content is instantly recognisable to the 18–34 audience. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• a) Best platform- Instagram or TikTok;
  • Reason- Highly visual ecosystem, audience characteristics, trend driven discovery,
  • engagement etc.;
  • Comparison- Instagram aligns perfectly with visual storytelling + trends , while
  • Facebook does not. ( 9 marks)
  • b) SMM strategies- Reels/ short form videos, sustainability focused contents, UGC
  • Campaigns, influencer collaborations, hashtag marketing etc. (valid explanation of any
  • of these or other strategies can be considered) (8 marks)
  • c) Mnemonics strategies- Signature visual style, signature content hook, Unique visual
  • elements or any other elements for instant recognition can be considered. ( 8 marks)

questions.question: A newly launched online wellness brand wants to build awareness and engagement through digital platforms such as Instagram, You Tube, and a company blog. The brand targets young working professionals (ages 22–35) who are interested in fitness, mental well-being, and healthy lifestyle choices. Currently, the brand posts content randomly without a fixed schedule or clear objectives. Management wants to develop a systematic content plan for the next one month to improve visibility, engagement, and lead generation. Based on the above situation, answer the following: a) Identify the content objectives for the brand. b) Define the target audience characteristics relevant to content planning. c) Suggest suitable content types and formats for each platform (Instagram, You Tube, Blog). d) Prepare a one-month content plan indicating: Content theme, Platform used, Frequency of posting and Type of content. / [CO3] [25x1 = 25]
questions.solution_html:
• a) Content Objectives - Build Brand Awareness, Increase Engagement, Educate
  • Audience, Generate Leads and Build Trust & Credibility. ( 5 marks)
  • b) Target Audience Characteristics
  • Demographic Factors - Age: 22–35 years, Occupation: Working professionals, Income:
  • Middle to upper-middle class
  • Psychographic Factors- Interested in fitness, mental health, healthy lifestyle, Busy lifestyle
  • → prefer quick, useful content, Value self-care and productivity
  • Behavioural Factors- Active on social media (Instagram, YouTube), Consumes video and
  • short-form content, Looks for practical tips and solutions ( 8 marks)
  • c) Content Types & Formats
  • Instagram- Reels (short workout videos, tips), Stories (polls, Q&A, daily tips), Carousel posts
  • (fitness guides, diet tips) and Motivational quotes
  • YouTube- Long-form videos (workout routines, wellness guides), Short videos (YouTube
  • Shorts), Expert interviews and Tutorials (meditation, stress relief)
  • Blog- Informative articles (fitness, diet, mental health), How-to guides, Case studies and SEO-
  • based content for traffic ( 6 marks)
  • d) One-Month Content Plan
  • Weekly Structure (Repeat for 4 Weeks) - Plan should contain week, theme, platform,
  • frequency and content type details.
  • Example- Week 1 – Brand Introduction- Platform – Instagram Frequency- 4 posts/week, Reels
  • etc. ( 6 marks)
  • (25x1=25)
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026
